data.label: Products
data.note:
The gradients of the previous frame moved by the flow so far, averaged with
the current frame's, and the products the window sums. The residual reads the moved
frame by cubic interpolation. Every pass of a level is the flow's size, its texel one over that size.

data.label: Window means
data.note:
A tent of `window` pixels at the level: along x here, along y in the solve,
which reads these rows itself rather than have a pass of its own write the result.

data.label: Solve
data.note:
(Σ∇∇ᵀ) d = -Σ∇·It for the step d in pixels, y up, about the window's means, so
an offset of brightness counts for nothing. Damping keeps the flow where there's less
texture than noise. Confidence is the smaller eigenvalue.
